info.title: F-Grade CRM Assistant API
info.description: Read-only natural-language Zoho CRM assistant for Microsoft Copilot Studio. The user's module is semantic intent, not a Zoho API name. The backend resolves that intent from live GET /settings/modules metadata, resolves every field from live GET /settings/fields metadata, validates filters/sorting/grouping/aggregations, selects an approved read API, and returns normalized CRM data. Copilot must never invent module_api_name values, field API names, snake_case names, or natural-language fields. CRM and Books are separate domains. The backend never substitutes another module; zero records remain zero records and module or field errors are returned.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Ask read-only questions about Zoho CRM. The user's explicit module is authoritative: Calls means Calls, Tasks means Tasks, Meetings maps only to Events, Products means Products, and Deals means Deals. Never substitute another module or default to Deals. Never send semantic, labels, descriptions, date phrases, or guessed snake_case as CRM fields. Do not invent module_api_name or field API names; the backend resolves both from live CRM metadata. Do not route CRM questions to Books. Zero records are valid results. For comparisons across modules, execute independent read queries and return each module name and module_api_name. Return MODULE_UNAVAILABLE or FIELD_NOT_AVAILABLE instead of replacing the request with another module's data. Never emit a Leads field named Converted; conversion questions must remain natural language.

post.description: Resolves record, count, aggregate, search, grouping, date, comparison, and metadata-driven questions against the exact explicitly requested CRM module. Products never becomes Deals; Meetings maps only to Events. Module availability and field validation occur before every Zoho read. Module and field errors are returned without fallback substitution.

404.description: Requested CRM module or field is unavailable

post.summary: Fast counts-only summary of today's CRM activity
post.description: Quick summary that returns counts per module for today's activity. Designed to finish quickly for connector time-limited environments.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Optional when the backend is deployed without BACKEND_API_KEY; required when that environment variable is configured.

module.description: Semantic CRM module intent such as Deals, Products, Calls, Tasks, or Meetings. This is not a Zoho API name. The backend resolves module_api_name from live module metadata; Copilot must not invent or rewrite it. Custom modules are supported. Meetings resolves only to Events, and the backend never substitutes another module.

request_type.description: records | count | aggregate | analysis | search | bulk_read. Fields, filters, sort, aggregate, and group_by are validated against live metadata before execution.

query.description: Optional structured query. The backend resolves semantic field labels through live metadata before execution. Supports filters with equals, not_equals, contains, starts_with, greater_than, less_than, greater_equal, less_equal, in, not_in, between, is_null, and is_not_null; nested filter_expression trees using AND, OR, and NOT; multi-field sort arrays; group_by; aggregate; having_filter for grouped aggregates; relationships; limit; and offset. Copilot must not invent API field names.

module_api_name.description: Backend-resolved Zoho CRM module API name. Copilot must not provide or invent this value.

fields.description: Backend-resolved live Zoho CRM API field names. Copilot must provide semantic field intent only and must not rewrite labels into API names.

filters.description: Validated filters applied to the resolved module.

comparisons.description: Independent comparison values for period or cross-module comparisons.

field.description: Semantic field term; backend resolves it to a live API name.

CrmDiagnostics.description: Safe request-pipeline diagnostics. Values are optional and never contain credentials or CRM record contents.

ResolvedCrmField.description: Safe metadata resolution diagnostic. Never contains credentials or record contents.
